_doc: THE CONTRACT for Sun & Steel sprites. Names, sizes and frame counts are binding. Raw AI images: games/tactics/art/raw/<name>.png; converted sprites: games/tactics/assets/sprites/sun_steel/<name>.<frame>.png (frame index from 0).

game.filter: nearest, 1 texel = 1 logical pixel (no mixed pixel densities)
game.board: 12 x 10 cells of 24 x 24 px (288 x 240), camera 3/4 top-down like a handheld tactics game
game.unit_anchor: unit sprites are 32 x 32; the unit stands centred on its 24 px cell with its feet on rows 28-30 of the canvas, so heads may overlap the cell above
game.light: single light from the top-left; 1 px dark outline (ink.0 or the darkest step of the local ramp; selective outlining allowed)
game.idle_animation: 4 frames at about 6 fps; frames must differ visibly but keep the same silhouette centre and feet row
game.humanoid_height: humanoid heroes share one body height: target_height px from the top of the head (or helmet/hood) to the soles, before the 1 px outline, so the roster reads at one scale

sprites.name: unit_sun_knight
sprites.brief: Player hero, tank class. Heavy plate armour in steel ramp with gold trim, a round sun emblem on a tall shield (gold), a crimson cape, longsword held low. Faces the viewer, turned slightly right (3/4). Idle: 1 px breathing bob, cape hem sways, the sun emblem glints on one frame.

sprites.name: unit_golem
sprites.brief: Enemy. A hulking basalt golem (stone ramp, darker and heavier than the heroes) with magma cracks (ember ramp) and a glowing core in the chest, small head sunk between huge shoulders, fists near the ground. Faces the viewer, turned slightly left. Idle: shoulders heave 1 px, cracks and core pulse brighter on two frames. Must read as enemy at a glance against the heroes.

sprites.name: unit_pyromancer
sprites.brief: Player hero, ranged area-damage caster. Hooded battle-mage in crimson and ember robes with gold trim, a long staff topped with a burning orb (ember/gold), a small flame curling in the free hand. Faces the viewer, turned slightly right (3/4). Idle: robe hem sways, the staff flame flickers through 3 shapes, embers rise.

sprites.name: unit_frost_blade
sprites.brief: Player hero, fast melee duelist. Light armour in blue ramp with steel plates, a short fur-trimmed half-cape, a slim curved ice blade (teal/white) held ready. Faces the viewer, turned slightly right (3/4), lighter stance than the knight. Idle: weight shifts 1 px, blade edge glints, frost motes drift.

sprites.name: unit_ranger
sprites.brief: Player hero, long-range archer. Hooded scout in forest-green cloak over brown leather (stone ramp), a tall longbow held vertically at the side (not drawn out wide), quiver on the back, gold sun clasp. Faces the viewer, turned slightly right (3/4). Idle: cloak sways, fingers tap the string, hood shadow shifts.

sprites.name: unit_cleric
sprites.brief: Player hero, healer. Priest in pale robes (ink light ramp, near-white) with gold sun vestments, a short mace or sceptre topped with a sun disc, a soft gold halo glow near the hands. Faces the viewer, turned slightly right (3/4). Idle: robe sways, the sun disc pulses, small light motes.

sprites.name: tile_floor
sprites.brief: Shrine floor: weathered flagstones (stone ramp), low contrast and low saturation so units pop. Must tile seamlessly with itself in any grid (edges wrap). Structured detail (seams, chips, a few cracks), no random speckle.

sprites.name: tile_lava
sprites.brief: Hazard: molten lava (ember + gold ramps) with darker crust plates that drift between frames. Must tile seamlessly with itself on every frame. Brighter than the floor so the hazard is unmistakable.

sprites.name: prop_cover_rock
sprites.brief: Cover: a waist-high boulder (stone ramp) with a little moss (forest ramp), transparent background, placed on top of tile_floor. Short shadow toward the bottom-right drawn with opaque dark pixels (ordered dither allowed). Fills roughly the lower two-thirds of the cell.
